name: mi-control-financiero-web
description: Mi Control Financiero — app web estática (HTML + Tailwind + JS vanilla) para Android vía Capacitor

scripts.data: node --input-type=module -e "import {writeFileSync,mkdirSync} from 'node:fs'; import {buildSeedData} from './src/seed.js'; mkdirSync('data',{recursive:true}); writeFileSync('data/app-data.json', JSON.stringify(buildSeedData(), null, 2) + '\n'); console.log('data/app-data.json generado')"
